A [[Near-Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was '''captain''' of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. A few [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he moved a team of [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|operatives]] from a [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] to [[Titan Base]] to prepare for a [[Operation: Shell Game|mission]]. He was laconic and surly, and closed the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] off during the trip.

==Behind the scenes==
The captain appears in "[[Operation: Shell Game (adventure)|Operation: Shell Game]]," the adventure in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beta|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Beta]], released at [[Gen Con Game Fair]] in [[2013]].
